title: Dominic and the Promise
author: Xanthe Montrose
blurb: Coral Halloran, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
